narrative: The NSA's MCP guidance ranks tool-poisoning highest-severity because malicious server metadata enters the agent's context with instruction-level authority before human review - the untrusted-text-into-a-privileged-agent path this thesis names. Bleeding Llama (CVE-2026-7482, CVSS 9.1) lets an unauthenticated attacker leak API keys, system prompts and other users' data from 300,000-plus exposed Ollama servers, making the secret-exfiltration mechanism a measured, recurring class.
remaining_gap: Today's artifacts are CVEs and government design guidance, not a CIS or OWASP risk list that names Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration as a top-ranked category.
